codeReview.summary: The commit adds a dedicated CrossUserAuthorizationTest suite with broad cross-user isolation coverage for categories and transactions, validates FakeAuthFilter multi-user behavior via X-User-Id, and includes a stability fix for CategoryControllerTest cleanup. Service-layer authorization scoping remains correctly enforced via user-scoped repository calls. No blocking implementation issues were found for this feature.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Feature-level expected behavior references GET/PUT/DELETE by ID for categories and transactions, but controllers only implement list GET plus PUT/DELETE by ID. This creates acceptance ambiguity for future workers/reviewers.
The backend-worker skill enforces a strict TDD red phase even for verification/audit features where implementation may already be correct; this mismatch was called out in the worker handoff.

summary: Pass: authorization-isolation coverage is comprehensive for the implemented API surface, FakeAuthFilter multi-user behavior is explicitly tested, and no feature-blocking defects were identified in the reviewed commit.
